Its complete exact vertex-metric Rips topology is a natural missing comparator to the published dodecahedral graph of the same vertex count, valency and diameter, with a dramatic contrast of 19 versus one two-sphere at threshold two and one versus nine three-spheres at threshold three. The all-scale classification and complete 240-element symmetry representations determine concrete quotient homology and field-independent barcodes not inferred from graph symmetry parameters alone. This is a motivated natural invariant and exact complete classification, not an arbitrary finite slice.
